priority_holds.reason: Six separate Jacob Herreyns I Life of Christ paintings at KMSKA. Commons/Lukasweb trace six compositions, but no direct KMSKA accession number per scene. KMSKA site has unrelated Ensor Christ cycle and Rubens Baptism; don't conflate.
Bruges St Jerome by Bruno van Hollebeke has tentative 0000.GRO0420.I in Commons/Wikidata. An Anaïs Bouvy image is also mislabeled with this accession. Official object-level attribution needed.

Lille Quellinus Solomon/Sheba has Commons plus Wikidata crosswalk, but official source could not be accessed; different Lille Dirck van Delen Solomon/Sheba is P 233. Do not borrow P233 or count P190 before official confirmation.
Jordaens Saint Matthew and two apostles provisionally linked to Lille P85, but exact primary museum notice inaccessible.
Geneva Visitation crosswalk secondary; a later attribution to Champaigne's workshop conflicts with plain artist name in Commons. Museum direct object unavailable.

Lille official Dérision du Christ by Cranach school (P740) and Jésus insulté par les soldats after Valentin de Boulogne (P417) are unrelated to provisional Ter Brugghen selected image. No false match.
Toulouse Christ ressuscité selected photograph previously conflict with Les Âmes du Purgatoire official catalogue. Remains held.
